meta.title: Context curation
meta.description: Human-in-the-loop context curation workbench: mark turns or single messages to keep verbatim (Important), summarize normally (Default) or drop outright (Minor), rewrite user, assistant, tool-result and injected-context messages in place without a model call, then compress the marked ranges (Default blocks get model-written summaries, Minor blocks are dropped) or run the official /compact. A local JSON backup is written before every write to the session.
